user_reported_bug: Real user testing surfaced 4 issues: P0 catalogue accuracy regression where object-locked wall Paint / undefined family / flooring surfaces were matched to Laminates with high confidence; rug pin placement should prefer polygon centroid; hover highlight should be clearer and dim other cards; shortlisted swatches need click-to-enlarge lightbox.
summary: No relevant testing skill found. Focused verification shows the core confident wall-paint -> laminate leak is fixed for object-locked Paint rows and live real-image analysis, but the overall bug set is not fixed: shortlisted catalogue swatches do not render a clickable swatch because the backend drops swatch fields, and an object-locked wall with undefined/Other family can still search/return Laminates above Paint.

critical.issue: ShortlistItemCreate/add_shortlist_item do not persist swatch_crop_b64, color_hex, or material_code. Frontend sends these fields, but the saved shortlist item only contains name/source/match_percent/category/zone/notes/image_ref/external_url, so shortlisted catalogue swatches cannot render/enlarge.

Edge case from the user report is still reproducible in direct backend testing: object_type='wall' with material_family='Other'/undefined and family_alternatives=['Laminate'] returns a top Laminate match (72%) ahead of a Paint match (71%) because Brain allows ['Paints','Laminates'] even while object_locked=True. This is lower than the originally reported 80%, but it still demonstrates the undefined-wall cross-family leak is not fully gated/penalized.

ui_bugs.issue: After adding a catalogue recommendation to the shortlist, [data-testid='shortlist-swatch-0'] did not exist, so the lightbox could not be opened. Root cause is backend persistence dropping swatch/color fields, not the lightbox component itself.

integration_issues.flow: Analysis page catalogue recommendation -> Add recommendation to shortlist -> Shortlist swatch lightbox
integration_issues.issue: UI click successfully adds an item, but the persisted shortlist item lacks swatch_crop_b64/color_hex/material_code; no clickable swatch button renders.

action_items: Persist swatch_crop_b64, color_hex, and material_code in ShortlistItemCreate/add_shortlist_item and return them from GET /shortlist so the lightbox can render.

Tighten materialmatch_brain handling for object-locked wall/ceiling rows with material_family Other/undefined: do not let Laminates outrank Paints for plain matte wall surfaces, or return no confident match if the family remains genuinely ambiguous.

Add an explicit regression test for object_type='wall', material_family='Other', family_confidence<0.7, family_alternatives=['Laminate'] so undefined-family rows do not surface top laminate recommendations.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/src/pages/Analysis.jsx addCatalogueMatchToShortlist sends swatch_crop_b64/color_hex/material_code, but backend/server.py ShortlistItemCreate omits these fields and add_shortlist_item never stores them.

backend/server.py materialmatch_brain lines around the architectural painted surfaces route default unknown/Other wall surfaces to ['Paints','Laminates'] with object_locked=True; _find_catalogue_matches correctly skips low-confidence widen, but the initial Brain allow-list is already too broad for this user-reported undefined wall case.
seed_data_creation: Created fresh API users/projects for real-image analysis and a seeded analysis project for shortlist lightbox UI verification. Test data only; no product code changed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest suite passed (22/22). rca_of_the_issue: The main P0 widen-block fix works for confident object-locked Paint rows, but undefined wall handling remains too broad at Brain routing time. Separately, the frontend lightbox implementation cannot work end-to-end because the backend Pydantic model/API persistence silently discards the swatch fields the frontend sends.
